verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no export feature, dump endpoint, or machine-readable export format for memories. The document list/get API (docs-60) is only a building block a developer could use to assemble an export. The self-hosted binary and the migration guides (aimed at moving into Supermemory) are adjacent features, not export capability.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can export memories in a machine-readable format so the memory store is portable and not a lock-in trap
